review: 611.2a-2: the new_object variant changed several facts and illustrated 400.7 (a new object) rather than the stated duration, and a decision said 'instead of Purelace' with no Purelace in the scenario; replaced it with a Crimson Wisps variant (same color change, 'until end of turn') and trimmed Unsummon, Island and the extra Forests.
611.2d-1: the first variant was labelled 'after_resolution'; relabelled it 'base'.
611.2e-1: 'it gets a +1/+1 counter (2/2)' read as Grizzly Bears getting the counter; named Champion of the Perished explicitly in both expectations.

611.3b-1: the base decisions had both players pass with an empty stack, which ends main1 before the board is read; the base now reads the board with no action and the variant states the Disenchant sequence in full.

611.3d: the skip claimed no Forge card grants a castable ability with battlefield-only parts, but Henzie "Toolbox" Torre grants blitz (haste, a dies-draw trigger and an end-step sacrifice) to creature spells; removed the skip and added 611.3d-1.

scenarios.title: A continuous effect from a resolved spell ends when its stated duration ends
decisions: A casts Giant Growth targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Forest.
Both players pass; Giant Growth resolves.
Both players pass through combat and main2 to the end step; the board is read at the end step (base) or after the cleanup step (variant).

variants.label: base
variants.expected: At the end step Grizzly Bears is 5/5: the +3/+3 is still applied. Giant Growth is in A's graveyard.

variants.label: after_cleanup
variants.delta: The board is read after the cleanup step of the same turn instead of at the end step.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is 2/2 again: the 'until end of turn' effect ended in the cleanup step.

scenarios.title: A continuous effect with no stated duration lasts until the end of the game
decisions: A casts Chaoslace targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Mountain.
Both players pass; Chaoslace resolves.
Both players pass through combat, main2 and the end of turn; the board is read at the beginning of B's upkeep.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: At B's upkeep Grizzly Bears is still red: Chaoslace's color change states no duration and lasts until the end of the game. It is 2/2.

variants.label: until_end_of_turn
variants.delta: A casts Crimson Wisps targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Mountain, instead of Chaoslace.
variants.expected: A draws Forest. At B's upkeep Grizzly Bears is green again and has no haste: Crimson Wisps' 'until end of turn' color change ended in A's cleanup step.

scenarios.forge_notes: Chaoslace is Animate with Duration$ Permanent; Crimson Wisps' Animate has no Duration$ and so lasts until end of turn.

scenarios.title: A 'for as long as you control it' effect whose duration ended before it began does nothing
decisions: A casts Master Thief, tapping four Islands; both players pass; Master Thief resolves and enters.
Its enters trigger goes on the stack targeting Ornithopter.
A passes priority; B casts Lightning Bolt targeting Master Thief, tapping Mountain; B passes, then A passes; Lightning Bolt resolves.
Both players pass; the enters trigger resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Lightning Bolt deals 3 damage to Master Thief (2/2), which dies before the trigger resolves. The trigger resolves and does nothing: Ornithopter stays under B's control and never changes controller.

variants.label: no_response
variants.delta: B does not cast Lightning Bolt; both players pass and the trigger resolves with Master Thief still on the battlefield.
variants.expected: The trigger resolves and A gains control of Ornithopter for as long as A controls Master Thief; Ornithopter is on A's side of the battlefield.

scenarios.forge_notes: Master Thief uses GainControl with LoseControl$ LeavesPlay,LoseControl; Forge should skip the effect when the host has already left the battlefield.

scenarios.title: A resolved effect that changes characteristics affects only the creatures present when it resolves
decisions: A casts Glorious Charge, tapping Plains and Forest; both players pass; it resolves.
A casts Ambush Viper, tapping Plains and Forest; both players pass; it resolves and enters.
The board is read in main1.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is 3/3 until end of turn. Ambush Viper, which entered after Glorious Charge resolved, is 2/1: it is not in the set the effect locked in.

variants.label: viper_first
variants.delta: A casts and resolves Ambush Viper first, then Glorious Charge.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is 3/3 and Ambush Viper is 3/2: it was on the battlefield when Glorious Charge resolved.

scenarios.title: A resolved effect that modifies the rules of the game also reaches creatures that enter later

setup.notes: Grizzly Bears has been under A's control since before this turn, so it can attack.

decisions: A passes priority in the beginning of combat step; B casts Holy Day, tapping Plains; both players pass; it resolves.
A attacks B with Grizzly Bears.
In the declare attackers step B casts Ambush Viper, tapping Plains and Forest; both players pass; it resolves and enters.
B blocks Grizzly Bears with Ambush Viper. Both players pass into combat damage.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Ambush Viper entered after Holy Day resolved, yet the combat damage Grizzly Bears and Ambush Viper would deal is prevented: no damage is dealt, both creatures survive and B's life is 20.

variants.label: no_holy_day
variants.delta: B does not cast Holy Day and keeps its Plains untapped; the rest is unchanged.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears deals 2 damage to Ambush Viper (toughness 1) and Ambush Viper deals deathtouch damage to Grizzly Bears: both creatures die.

scenarios.forge_notes: Holy Day is the Fog effect; Forge implements prevention as a replacement effect, so it should apply to a blocker that entered after resolution.

scenarios.title: A variable in a continuous effect is evaluated once, on resolution
decisions: A casts Chorus of Might targeting Hill Giant, tapping four Forests.
Both players pass; Chorus of Might resolves.
B casts Lightning Bolt targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Mountain; both players pass; it resolves.
The board is read in main1.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Chorus of Might resolves with X = 2 (Hill Giant and Grizzly Bears): Hill Giant is 5/5 with trample. Lightning Bolt then kills Grizzly Bears, and Hill Giant stays 5/5 because X was fixed on resolution.

variants.label: in_response
variants.delta: B casts Lightning Bolt in response to Chorus of Might, before it resolves, instead of after.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears dies first, so Chorus of Might resolves with X = 1: Hill Giant is 4/4 with trample.

scenarios.title: An 'is a Zombie' effect applies as the permanent enters, so enters triggers see it
decisions: A casts Rise from the Grave targeting Grizzly Bears in A's graveyard, tapping five Swamps.
Both players pass; Rise from the Grave resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears enters under A's control as a black Zombie Bear, so Champion of the Perished's trigger fires and Champion of the Perished gets a +1/+1 counter (2/2).

variants.label: zombify
variants.delta: A casts Zombify instead of Rise from the Grave, tapping four Swamps.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears enters as a green Bear only; Champion of the Perished's trigger does not fire and Champion of the Perished stays 1/1 with no counter.

scenarios.forge_notes: Rise from the Grave applies its Zombie type through StaticEffect$ Animate; check that Forge applies it before the enters trigger is evaluated.

scenarios.title: A next-spell effect applies to the next appropriate spell cast, and only that one
decisions: A casts Insist, tapping Forest; both players pass; it resolves and A draws Forest.
A casts Grizzly Bears, tapping two Forests.
B responds with Counterspell targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping two Islands; all stack objects resolve.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Insist's effect applies to Grizzly Bears as it is cast: Counterspell resolves but Grizzly Bears is not countered and enters the battlefield.

variants.label: second_creature
variants.delta: A first casts Runeclaw Bear, tapping two Forests, and B passes so it resolves; A then casts Grizzly Bears, tapping two Forests, and B casts Counterspell on it.
variants.expected: Runeclaw Bear took Insist's effect when it was cast; Grizzly Bears has no such effect and is countered, moving to A's graveyard.

scenarios.forge_notes: Insist uses a delayed SpellCast trigger that creates an Effect holding a replacement for Counter.

scenarios.title: A static ability's effect applies at each moment to whatever its text indicates

setup.notes: Savannah Lions is white (2/1) and has Crusade's bonus from the start (3/2).

decisions: A casts Purelace targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Plains; both players pass; it resolves.
The board is read in main1.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears becomes white and immediately gets Crusade's bonus: it is 3/3. Savannah Lions stays 3/2.

variants.label: turns_red
variants.delta: A casts Chaoslace targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Mountain, instead of Purelace.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears becomes red, not white, and gets no bonus: it stays 2/2. Savannah Lions stays 3/2.

variants.label: loses_white
variants.delta: A casts Chaoslace targeting Savannah Lions, tapping Mountain, instead of Purelace on Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Savannah Lions becomes red and loses Crusade's bonus: it is 2/1. Grizzly Bears stays 2/2.

scenarios.title: A static ability's effect applies exactly while its source is on the battlefield
decisions: No spell is cast; the board is read in main1 while A holds priority.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Crusade is on the battlefield, so Savannah Lions (white) is 3/2.

variants.label: destroyed
variants.delta: A passes priority in main1 and B casts Disenchant targeting Crusade, tapping two Plains; A passes; it resolves; the board is read afterwards in main1.
variants.expected: Crusade is destroyed and moves to A's graveyard; Savannah Lions loses the bonus and is 2/1.

scenarios.title: A static characteristic change applies as a permanent enters, before enters triggers are checked

setup.notes: In the no_anthem variant the battlefield holds a third Forest in place of Gaea's Anthem.

decisions: A casts Grizzly Bears, tapping two Forests; both players pass; it resolves and enters.
If Garruk's Packleader's trigger goes on the stack, A chooses to draw and it resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears (2/2) enters as a 3/3 thanks to Gaea's Anthem, so Garruk's Packleader's power-3-or-greater trigger fires and A draws Forest.

variants.label: no_anthem
variants.delta: Gaea's Anthem is not on the battlefield (A controls a third Forest instead).
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears enters as a 2/2; Garruk's Packleader's trigger does not fire and A draws nothing.

scenarios.title: Blitz granted to a creature spell by a static ability keeps its battlefield effects after the source leaves

setup.notes: Henzie gives each creature spell A casts with mana value 4 or greater blitz at a cost equal to its mana cost; no commander has been cast, so the blitz cost is not reduced.

decisions: A casts Hill Giant for its blitz cost {3}{R}, tapping four Mountains; both players pass; it resolves.
A passes priority; B casts Lightning Bolt targeting Henzie "Toolbox" Torre, tapping Mountain; both players pass; it resolves and Henzie dies.
In the declare attackers step A attacks B with Hill Giant if that is legal; B does not block.
Both players pass through main2 to the end step; the blitz sacrifice trigger and then the dies trigger resolve.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Henzie "Toolbox" Torre is in A's graveyard, yet Hill Giant keeps haste: it attacks and B goes to 17 life. At the end step Hill Giant is sacrificed and moves to A's graveyard, and A draws Forest.

variants.label: normal_cast
variants.delta: A casts Hill Giant for its mana cost instead of its blitz cost.
variants.expected: Hill Giant has no haste and cannot be declared as an attacker; B stays at 20 life. At the end step Hill Giant stays on the battlefield and A draws nothing.

scenarios.forge_notes: Henzie grants Blitz through AddKeyword$ Blitz to creature spells on the stack only; check that Forge keeps the blitz haste, dies-draw trigger and end-step sacrifice on the permanent after Henzie has left the battlefield.
